reference_sql:
WITH lowest_prices AS (
  SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS lowest_competitor_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
),
product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT lp.product_id, ph.list_price_eur, lp.lowest_competitor_eur, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units
FROM lowest_prices lp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = lp.product_id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = lp.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = lp.product_id
WHERE p.brand IN ('Vistara', 'Sonora', 'PlayBox')

solver.query:
WITH lowest AS (
  SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS lowest_competitor_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
), product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, h.list_price_eur, lo.lowest_competitor_eur, COALESCE(pu.units, 0) AS units
FROM products p
JOIN lowest lo ON lo.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id AND h.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand IN ('Vistara', 'Sonora', 'PlayBox')
